title: Continuous Discovery Framework
description: A weekly discovery process with UX, PM and Tech, where every insight can be traced back to its evidence
reto: When I arrived there was no clear or consistent product discovery process. Each area worked from isolated information, and decisions were driven more by intuition than by data or evidence. The challenge was to design and roll out a continuous discovery framework that would align practices across teams (UX, PM, Tech, advisors), produce actionable weekly insights, give traceability from evidence through to learnings, insights, hypotheses and experiments, and be sustainable over time rather than depending on one-off efforts.

proceso.investigacion: I rolled out the framework by presenting its core principles: continuous discovery, the UX/PM/Tech product trio, and visualization through an Opportunity Solution Tree. I ran a walkthrough of the opportunity tree and of the templates for evidence, learnings and insights, and assigned sources and owners.
proceso.diseno: I defined a structured working rhythm. Each week, each team member analyzes one source (Intercom, calls, reviews, interviews) and documents evidence and learnings, and on Fridays we hold a synthesis and prioritization meeting. Each month we choose a desired outcome, for example improving conversion, and update the tree. Each quarter I present a Discovery Digest with key insights, prioritized opportunities, experiments run and roadmap adjustments.
proceso.desarrollo: For collaboration I chose Google Sheets for structured, traceable documentation, FigJam and Miro to visualize the tree, and Figma and Google Meet to validate prototypes. I brought advisors in as discovery champions to share findings, and added PM and Tech to the monthly reviews so prioritized insights feed roadmap decisions.

resultados: UX, PM and Tech reviewing insights together every month
Living, traceable documentation that links evidence, learnings, insights, hypotheses and experiments
aprendizajes: Piling up findings is pointless unless they become prioritized opportunities that steer the roadmap. Every insight has to be traceable back to its original evidence. Teams adopt the process when they take part from the start. And discovery never stops. It takes consistency every week.
